statement: A billing monitor runs with a read-only credential scoped to node metrics and summaries, mounted read-only at /opt/creds (API URL, cluster CA, bearer token file). From the provided shell and that credential, recover the current ledger snapshot token held by the sync workload. The workload itself is not directly reachable from your network. Submit the token as captured.
ready_cmd: kubectl --kubeconfig /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml wait --for=condition=Ready pod/ledger-sync-01 -n billing --timeout=45s && test -s /creds/monitor-token && kubectl --kubeconfig /etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml --token="$(cat /creds/monitor-token)" get --raw /api/v1/nodes/k3s-agt-01/proxy/pods | grep -q ledger-sync-01
